001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.localization.text;
002
003import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
004import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
005
006import java.text.NumberFormat;
007import java.util.Locale;
008import java.util.Objects;
009
010public class ProxiedLocale {
011
012  private Locale locale;
013  @Nullable
014  private String origin;
015  private String relative;
016  private NumberFormat nf;
017
018  public ProxiedLocale(@Nullable final String origin, final String relative, @NotNull final NumberFormat nf, @NotNull final Locale locale) {
019
020    this.origin = origin;
021    this.relative = relative;
022    this.nf = nf;
023    this.locale = locale;
024  }
025
026  public String getLocale() {
027
028    return relative;
029  }
030
031  @NotNull
032  public NumberFormat getNumberFormat() {
033
034    return nf;
035  }
036
037  @NotNull
038  public Locale getJavaLocale() {
039
040    return locale;
041  }
042
043  @Nullable
044  public String getOrigin() {
045
046    return this.origin;
047  }
048
049  public String getRelative() {
050
051    return this.relative;
052  }
053
054  public NumberFormat getNf() {
055
056    return this.nf;
057  }
058
059  public void setLocale(final Locale locale) {
060
061    this.locale = locale;
062  }
063
064  public void setOrigin(@Nullable final String origin) {
065
066    this.origin = origin;
067  }
068
069  public void setRelative(final String relative) {
070
071    this.relative = relative;
072  }
073
074  public void setNf(final NumberFormat nf) {
075
076    this.nf = nf;
077  }
078
079  @Override
080  public boolean equals(final Object o) {
081
082    if(o == this) return true;
083    if(!(o instanceof ProxiedLocale)) return false;
084    final ProxiedLocale other = (ProxiedLocale)o;
085    return Objects.equals(this.getLocale(), other.getLocale())
086           && Objects.equals(this.getOrigin(), other.getOrigin())
087           && Objects.equals(this.getRelative(), other.getRelative())
088           && Objects.equals(this.getNf(), other.getNf());
089  }
090
091  @Override
092  public int hashCode() {
093
094    return Objects.hash(this.getLocale(), this.getOrigin(), this.getRelative(), this.getNf());
095  }
096
097  @Override
098  public String toString() {
099
100    return "ProxiedLocale(locale=" + this.getLocale() + ", origin=" + this.getOrigin() + ", relative=" + this.getRelative() + ", nf=" + this.getNf() + ")";
101  }
102}
